description: Legal Affairs Development - Banking (Amendment) Act, No 24 of 2024, Order under Subsection (2) of section 1
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the implementation of a banking law amendment (Banking (Amendment) Act, No. 24 of 2024). It contains an order by the Minister of Finance appointing the effective date for the Act's provisions to come into operation. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with the implementation of legislation and regulatory frameworks, specifically in the banking sector. While it mentions a government official (Ranil Wickremesinghe), it does so in the context of executing legal/regulatory authority rather than detailing government structure or personnel changes.
